definition: to move your body to music
description: A night dive on white sand: two black-gloved hands hold out a small action camera and an octopus reaches out and takes it. The picture then becomes the octopus's own point of view — its head and arms in the foreground as it crawls low over the sand, past dark rocks, and down a narrow gully. It arrives in what looks like an underwater nightclub: glowing red jellyfish hang overhead like lamps, blue laser beams sweep the water, and a crowd of octopuses, one wearing white sunglasses, waves its arms and dances under the lights.
